name: @kaoiro/wrapper-meta
description: wrapper 4 パッケージ (core / agent-common / claude-code / codex) への fan-out scripts。workspace 非メンバの shim (ADR-0017 / ADR-0032 F1)

scripts.demo: for f in agent.*.json; do node claude-code/dist/cli.js "$f" & done; wait
scripts.dev: for f in agent.*.json; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; ./claude-code/node_modules/.bin/tsx watch claude-code/src/cli.ts "$f" & done; wait
